analyst_summary: June 15, 2026 opens at Vibe 5 — the first morning upgrade in the post-Hormuz arc. Trump declared the deal 'now complete' following the June 14 morning brief; naval blockade dissolution has begun; oil sanctions waiver is active; $25B assets release is initiated; formal signing ceremony is June 19 Geneva. The 108-day Hormuz conflict arc is in its resolution phase. Downstream effects are cascading simultaneously: Brent dissolving toward $78-84; May CPI 4.2% YoY is almost certainly the commodity inflation peak; rate cut window for 2026 has reopened; FC Iran-war-cost leverage on Reconciliation 2.0 is dissolved; the most persistent political liability for House Republicans (gasoline 40.5% YoY) is now a resolving cost of a successful deal. Five structural risk factors sustain the Vibe 5 ceiling. First: Israel Beirut strikes (3 dead) and Trump's 'Don't Blow It' warning — Lebanon ceasefire Day 30 is under stress at the most sensitive pre-signing moment; Israeli escalation before June 19 Geneva is the highest-probability deal disruption pathway now available; Hezbollah retaliation potential would reopen a second front as the principal arc closes. Second: FOMC T-1 — Warsh's inaugural June 16-17 SEP meeting is releasing a full rate path dot plot against baseline assumptions made partially obsolete by the deal declaration 15+ hours ago; hawkish 2026 dot plot projections under a resolving supply shock would be analytically awkward and market-destabilizing; Warsh's inaugural press conference carries dual mandate at maximum complexity. Third: PNW heat-FIFA-wildfire triple convergence at simultaneous peak — Extreme Heat Warning Peak Day 2 (95-100°F), FIFA Seattle opener today at noon PT (SEAR-2, potential Seattle all-time high), and Rimrock Lake wildfire (new named fire, military aircraft origin, initial attack) represent the highest co-response activation day of the NIFC-FIFA co-response mandate. Fourth: Measles CIDRAP slowing signal Day 8 faces the single highest amplification-risk day of the 2026 outbreak arc — Lumen Field SEAR-2 + Let's Play SEA 26 Day 5 + heat immune suppression + international visitors + summer mobile phase = 185-215 cases from breaking the 2025 record. Fifth: Iran formal signing is four calendar days away. Primary watch items for June 15: (1) Rimrock Lake wildfire initial attack outcome under peak heat — any rapid growth = NIFC co-response stress at FIFA peak hour; (2) FIFA Seattle health and security outcome — any mass heat-related medical emergency; (3) Israeli escalation monitoring — Trump 'Don't Blow It' warning effectiveness; any additional Beirut strikes = Lebanon ceasefire collapse risk; (4) Brent market open Monday — $78-82 = dissolution Phase 1 pricing confirmed; $88+ = deal skepticism; (5) Measles new cluster tracing to FIFA-Seattle = outbreak acceleration signal; (6) FOMC blackout — any pre-meeting Fed communication carries maximum market weight.
